records.name: Abscopal effect (es)
records.text: Cuando irradiar un tumor hace que otros tumores no tratados se reduzcan, a través del sistema inmunitario.

records.name: In situ vaccination (es)
records.text: Tratar un tumor de forma tan agresiva que el sistema inmunitario aprenda a atacar todos los demás, usando el propio tumor como vacuna.

records.name: Lymph node (es)
records.text: Pequeños filtros con forma de judía situados a lo largo de los vasos linfáticos donde se reúnen las células inmunitarias. Suelen ser el primer lugar al que se extiende un cáncer, por lo que los cirujanos los examinan para ver hasta dónde ha llegado la enfermedad.

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (es)
Abscopal effect (zh)
records.text: 照射一个肿瘤使别处未治疗的肿瘤通过免疫系统缩小。

records.name: In situ vaccination (zh)
records.text: 对一个肿瘤进行极为强力的治疗，使免疫系统学会攻击其他所有肿瘤，把肿瘤本身当作疫苗。

records.name: Lymph node (zh)
records.text: 沿淋巴管分布的豆形小过滤器，免疫细胞在此聚集。它们常常是癌症扩散的第一站，因此外科医生会检查它们以了解疾病进展的程度。

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (zh)
Abscopal effect (pt)
records.text: Quando irradiar um tumor faz tumores não tratados em outros lugares encolherem, via sistema imune.

records.name: In situ vaccination (pt)
records.text: Tratar um tumor de forma tão agressiva que o sistema imunitário aprende a atacar todos os outros, usando o próprio tumor como vacina.

records.name: Lymph node (pt)
records.text: Pequenos filtros em forma de feijão ao longo dos vasos linfáticos onde as células imunes se reúnem. Costumam ser o primeiro local para onde um câncer se espalha, por isso os cirurgiões os examinam para ver até onde a doença chegou.

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (pt)
Abscopal effect (hi)
records.text: जब एक ट्यूमर को विकिरित करने से प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र के ज़रिये अन्यत्र अनुपचारित ट्यूमर सिकुड़ते हैं।

records.name: In situ vaccination (hi)
records.text: एक ट्यूमर का इतना आक्रामक उपचार करना कि प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र बाकी सभी ट्यूमरों पर हमला करना सीख जाए, ट्यूमर को ही टीके के रूप में उपयोग करते हुए।

records.name: Lymph node (hi)
records.text: लसीका वाहिकाओं के साथ स्थित छोटे, सेम के आकार के फिल्टर, जहां प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाएं एकत्र होती हैं। ये अक्सर वह पहली जगह होते हैं जहां कैंसर फैलता है, इसलिए सर्जन इन्हें जांचते हैं कि बीमारी कितनी दूर तक पहुंची है।

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (hi)
Abscopal effect (fr)
records.text: Lorsque l'irradiation d'une tumeur fait régresser des tumeurs non traitées situées ailleurs, par l'intermédiaire du système immunitaire.

records.name: In situ vaccination (fr)
records.text: Traiter une tumeur si vigoureusement que le système immunitaire apprend à attaquer toutes les autres, en utilisant la tumeur elle-même comme vaccin.

records.name: Lymph node (fr)
records.text: Petits filtres en forme de haricot le long des vaisseaux lymphatiques où se rassemblent les cellules immunitaires. Ils sont souvent le premier endroit où un cancer se propage, et les chirurgiens les examinent donc pour voir jusqu'où la maladie s'est étendue.

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (fr)
Abscopal effect (de)
records.text: Wenn die Bestrahlung eines Tumors dazu führt, dass unbehandelte Tumoren an anderer Stelle schrumpfen, vermittelt durch das Immunsystem.

records.name: In situ vaccination (de)
records.text: Einen Tumor so aggressiv behandeln, dass das Immunsystem lernt, alle anderen anzugreifen, wobei der Tumor selbst als Impfstoff dient.

records.name: Lymph node (de)
records.text: Kleine bohnenförmige Filter entlang der Lymphgefäße, in denen sich Immunzellen sammeln. Sie sind oft der erste Ort, an den sich ein Krebs ausbreitet, deshalb untersuchen Chirurgen sie, um zu sehen, wie weit die Krankheit fortgeschritten ist.

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (de)
Abscopal effect (ja)
records.text: 一つの腫瘍に放射線を照射すると、免疫系を介して、別の場所にある未治療の腫瘍も縮小する現象である。

records.name: In situ vaccination (ja)
records.text: 1つの腫瘍を徹底的に治療することで、免疫系が他のすべての腫瘍を攻撃するよう学習させる手法。腫瘍そのものをワクチンとして利用する。

records.name: Lymph node (ja)
records.text: リンパ管に沿って並ぶ豆の形をした小さなフィルターで、免疫細胞が集まる場所。がんが最初に広がる場所であることが多いため、外科医は病気がどこまで進んでいるかを見るためにこれを調べる。

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (ja)
Abscopal effect (ar)
records.text: عندما يؤدي تشعيع ورم واحد إلى انكماش أورام أخرى غير معالجة في مواضع أخرى من الجسم، عبر الجهاز المناعي.

records.name: In situ vaccination (ar)
records.text: معالجة ورم واحد بقوة شديدة بحيث يتعلم الجهاز المناعي مهاجمة جميع الأورام الأخرى، باستخدام الورم نفسه كلقاح.

records.name: Lymph node (ar)
records.text: مرشحات صغيرة على شكل حبة الفاصولياء على امتداد الأوعية اللمفاوية تتجمع فيها الخلايا المناعية. وهي غالباً أول موقع ينتشر إليه السرطان، لذلك يفحصها الجراحون لمعرفة مدى انتشار المرض.

records.name: Macrophage states beyond M1 and M2 (ar)
Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) (simple)
records.text: Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes are lymphocytes in tumour tissue. Location, cell identity, the measurement denominator and useful function are separate questions.

records.name: Hot vs cold tumours (simple)
records.text: Hot, excluded and desert describe where specified immune cells were found in a sample. These patterns alone do not show cancer recognition, killing or treatment benefit.

records.name: Immune surveillance and cancer immunoediting (simple)
records.text: Immune responses can control cancer and select which populations persist. Immunoediting is a testable framework, not a way to assign a phase or recurrence risk from one scan.

records.name: Abscopal effect (simple)
records.text: When irradiating one tumour makes untreated tumours elsewhere shrink, through the immune system.

records.name: In situ vaccination (simple)
records.text: In situ vaccination treats one tumour so aggressively that the immune system learns to attack every other one, using the tumour itself as the vaccine.

records.name: Lymph node (simple)
records.text: Lymph nodes are small bean-shaped filters where immune cells gather, often the first place a cancer spreads, so surgeons check them to see how far it has gone.

effective.effectiveText: Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes are lymphocytes found in tumour tissue. Their identity, location, measurement denominator and function answer different questions.

Hot, excluded and desert describe where specified immune cells were found in sampled tissue. Their location alone does not establish tumour recognition, effective killing or benefit from a particular drug.
Immune responses can control cancer and select which populations persist. Immunoediting is a testable framework, not a way to assign a phase or recurrence risk from one scan.

HLA molecules sit on cells and hold up small pieces of the cell's proteins for T cells to inspect. A T cell reads the fragment together with the particular HLA version holding it.
A conventional T-cell receptor recognises a peptide together with its HLA display. Recognition alone does not show killing.
